teaser.en: A hooked-thorn scrambler whose small berries turn from red to purple-black, and birds strip them fast.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachotambaa chenye miiba ya ndoano, ambacho beri zake ndogo hubadilika kutoka nyekundu hadi zambarau-nyeusi, na ndege huzimaliza haraka.

summary.en: *Chinyokola* is a spiny scrambling shrub with glossy leaves and small berries that ripen purple-black. The ripe fruit is edible.
summary.sw: *Chinyokola* ni kichaka kinachotambaa chenye miiba, majani yanayong'aa na beri ndogo zinazoiva zikawa za zambarau-nyeusi. Tunda lililoiva huliwa.

about.en: *Scutia myrtina* is a spiny, often scrambling shrub up to about 6 m. Its spreading branches carry recurved thorns, usually in pairs, grey with shiny brown tips. The leaves are glossy mid-green, oval and up to 6 cm long. The small, creamy-green, bell-shaped flowers grow in clusters, and the berries, up to 1 cm across, turn from green to red and then purple-black when ripe.
about.sw: *Scutia myrtina* ni kichaka chenye miiba, ambacho mara nyingi hutambaa, kinachofikia takriban m 6. Matawi yake yanayotawanyika yana miiba iliyopinda nyuma, kwa kawaida kwa jozi, ya rangi ya kijivu yenye ncha za kahawia zinazong'aa. Majani yanang'aa, ya kijani cha wastani, ya umbo la yai na yenye urefu wa hadi sm 6. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu-kijani, yenye umbo la kengele, huota katika vishada, na beri, zenye upana wa hadi sm 1, hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi nyekundu kisha zambarau-nyeusi zinapoiva.

where.en: It is widespread from Kenya to South Africa and Madagascar, and east to India and Vietnam. ICRAF notes that in the dry lowlands it is confined to riverine vegetation, places near pools and swamps, and the seashore, often on coral soils and termite mounds. At the coast it fruits from January to April.
where.sw: Kinapatikana kwa wingi kuanzia Kenya hadi Afrika Kusini na Madagaska, na mashariki hadi India na Vietnam. ICRAF inaeleza kwamba katika nyanda kavu za chini hupatikana tu katika mimea ya kando ya mito, mahali karibu na madimbwi na vinamasi, na ufuoni mwa bahari, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa matumbawe na vichuguu. Pwani huzaa matunda kuanzia Januari hadi Aprili.

uses.en: ICRAF records that the ripe fruit is eaten, and that the roots and leaves are used as medicine. The shrub also gives fodder and shade. Birds and squirrels eat the fruit so readily that seed is hard to collect. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaeleza kwamba tunda lililoiva huliwa, na kwamba mizizi na majani hutumika kama dawa. Kichaka hiki pia hutoa lishe ya mifugo na kivuli. Ndege na kindi hula matunda kwa hamu kiasi kwamba ni vigumu kukusanya mbegu. Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chinyokola* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. ICRAF gives the Giriama name *munyahi*. 'Cat-thorn' is a common English name for the species.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chinyokola* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kigiriama *munyahi*. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *cat-thorn*.

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotambaa wenye miiba ya ndoano
Kichaka chenye miiba na beri zinazoliwa
